# chameleon_user (Resource)

Manages a Keycloak user with a matching Polaris principal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "alice_initial_password" {
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  description = "Initial password for Alice; rotate via Keycloak after first login."
}

resource "chameleon_user" "alice" {
  username   = "alice"
  email      = "alice@example.com"
  first_name = "Alice"
  last_name  = "Anderson"
  password   = var.alice_initial_password
  roles      = ["data_reader"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Initial password set at create time. Subsequent changes are NOT applied to the user; rotate via Keycloak directly.
- `username` (String) Keycloak username. Must be unique within the realm.

### Optional

- `email` (String) User email address.
- `first_name` (String) User given name.
- `last_name` (String) User family name.
- `roles` (List of String) Principal roles the matching Polaris principal is granted on creation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Username (used as the Terraform resource ID).
